name: Game Icon: Demon Kabuto Warlord
purpose: Primary App Icon Candidate C: Menacing Warlord Identity.
description: Fierce horned samurai battle helmet (Kabuto) and demon faceplate silhouette centered in a blazing crimson disc.
prompt: A masterwork minimalist 2D vector game app icon. A fierce Japanese samurai kabuto helmet with curved golden-crimson crescent horns and a demon mempo face mask, rendered as a bold solid near-black silhouette with glowing crimson-red eye slits and rim contours. (Directly centered in front of a giant perfectly smooth solid circular crimson-red sun:1.4). Pure solid black background, pristine circular symmetry, clean hard vector edges, vector game icon, no 3D rendering, no soft painting, no gradients, no text, no pixelation, no noise.
